description.message: Connect your X sign-in session to X-Bar after your confirmation.

intro.message: Your X session is linked to X-Bar after you confirm.

consent.message: Connect my X sign-in session to X-Bar on this Mac.

details.message: Transfers the three sign-in cookies needed to access your account. Choose Connect when ready. After connecting, X-Bar can refresh even when Safari is closed.

ready.message: Take your time enabling the extension and signing in to Safari.

confirm_first.message: Please confirm the session connection first.

app_not_ready.message: Open Safari connection setup in X-Bar and reconnect. You remain signed in to Safari.

success.message: Session linked. Setup completes when X-Bar verifies your account and today’s impressions.

expired.message: The request expired. You remain signed in to Safari. Please reconnect.

no_session.message: Sign in to X in Safari, allow access to x.com, then reconnect.

failed.message: Connection failed. You remain signed in to Safari. Please reconnect.
